name: partner-access-readiness-store-scope
executionConcern: partner identity, activation, trusted business scope, store selection, readiness and publication prerequisites
objective: Make Partner access and Store readiness derive only from Identity plus canonical DSH Partner/Store state, with explicit onboarding/publication readback and fail-closed scope handling across directly affected surfaces.
truthOwner: Identity for authentication/session; DSH for Partner/Store operational readiness and scope; WLT only for payout destination truth.

tasks.objective: Close Partner identity/readiness/Store-scope ownership end to end
tasks.currentProblem: Identity, Partner readiness, Store scope, field/operator gates, serviceability and payout prerequisites can become partially ready at different layers.
tasks.requiredChange: Trace and correct the authoritative access/readiness path; selected Store remains client intent and backend ownership authorization remains mandatory.
tasks.targetState: Only a valid Partner with canonical readiness and an authorized Store can enter Store-scoped operations; publication/readback reflects committed DSH/WLT prerequisites.
tasks.action: Correct the first authoritative divergence, migrate only affected Partner consumers/readbacks, remove obsolete local fallback when proven safe, then rerun linked checks.
mustNotChange: Do not add client-selected trusted platform/operator context.
Do not let app-partner self-approve activation/publication.
Do not move raw payout identifiers into DSH.
Do not broaden unrelated Workforce/HR behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Missing/incomplete/suspended/unauthorized Partner or Store fails closed.
Partner/operator/client readbacks converge on committed readiness/publication state.
tasks.rollback: Revert the focused implementation commit or roll forward at canonical owners while preserving data/audit evidence; never restore parallel truth.
tasks.commitBoundary: One focused U001 implementation commit after owner correction, consumer migration, cleanup and linked checks.

tasks.objective: Close session/device/push and recovery behavior for Partner access
tasks.currentProblem: Static runtime composition does not prove logout/restart/actor change, push rebinding or offline recovery cannot reuse stale Partner state.
tasks.requiredChange: Verify and correct session restoration, device fingerprint and push lifecycle without making device-local state an authorization source.
tasks.targetState: No stale token/device/push/local Store state can authorize or address another Partner and recovery re-reads canonical state.
tasks.action: Change only proven Partner session/runtime bindings and keep server authorization authoritative.
mustNotChange: Do not log tokens or secrets.
Do not make device fingerprint an authorization source.
Do not bypass server scope for developer convenience.
acceptanceCriteria: Logout/relogin cannot retain another Partner readback.
Restart/offline recovery does not fabricate ready state.
tasks.rollback: Revert the focused implementation commit while preserving canonical server behavior.
tasks.commitBoundary: Same focused U001 commit; do not split a second truth path.
